\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R152-first-pass-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to believe and to change.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item soft, hard, difficult, clever, lazy
  \item brave, calm, hungry, thirsty, fresh
  \item stale, ripe, raw, true, false
  \item rich, poor, young, strong, weak
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Soft? (\textbf{\pa{ਨਰਮ}}, \emph{naram}.) Hard? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਖ਼ਤ}}, \emph{sakht}.) Difficult? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੁਸ਼ਕਲ}}, \emph{mushkal}.) Clever? (\textbf{\pa{ਹੁਸ਼ਿਆਰ}}, \emph{hushiār}.) Lazy? (\textbf{\pa{ਆਲਸੀ}}, \emph{ālsī}.) Brave? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਹਾਦਰ}}, \emph{bahādar}.) Calm? (\textbf{\pa{ਸ਼ਾਂਤ}}, \emph{shā̃t}.) Hungry? (\textbf{\pa{ਭੁੱਖਾ}}, \emph{bhukkhā}.) Thirsty? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਿਆਸਾ}}, \emph{piāsā}.) Fresh? (\textbf{\pa{ਤਾਜ਼ਾ}}, \emph{tāzā}.) Stale? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੇਹਾ}}, \emph{behā}.) Ripe? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੱਕਾ}}, \emph{pakkā}.) Raw? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੱਚਾ}}, \emph{kaccā}.) True? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੱਚਾ}}, \emph{saccā}.) False? (\textbf{\pa{ਝੂਠਾ}}, \emph{jhūṭhā}.) Rich? (\textbf{\pa{ਅਮੀਰ}}, \emph{amīr}.) Poor? (\textbf{\pa{ਗ਼ਰੀਬ}}, \emph{garīb}.) Young? (\textbf{\pa{ਜਵਾਨ}}, \emph{javān}.) Strong? (\textbf{\pa{ਤਕੜਾ}}, \emph{takṛā}.) Weak? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਮਜ਼ੋਰ}}, \emph{kamzor}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Verbs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R152-second-pass-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to hide and to fall.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to hide, to fall, to teach, to lift, to jump
  \item to swim, to climb, to call, to use, to make
  \item to sew, to fill, to pull, to wake up, to drive
  \item to say, to live, to spend, to save, to sow
  \item to run, to wander, to stop, to believe, to change
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To hide? (\textbf{\pa{ਲੁਕਣਾ}}, \emph{lukṇā}.) To fall? (\textbf{\pa{ਡਿੱਗਣਾ}}, \emph{ḍiggṇā}.) To teach? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਿਖਾਉਣਾ}}, \emph{sikhāuṇā}.) To lift? (\textbf{\pa{ਚੁੱਕਣਾ}}, \emph{cukkṇā}.) To jump? (\textbf{\pa{ਟੱਪਣਾ}}, \emph{ṭappṇā}.) To swim? (\textbf{\pa{ਤਰਨਾ}}, \emph{tarnā}.) To climb? (\textbf{\pa{ਚੜ੍ਹਨਾ}}, \emph{caṛhnā}.) To call? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੁਲਾਉਣਾ}}, \emph{bulāuṇā}.) To use? (\textbf{\pa{ਵਰਤਣਾ}}, \emph{vartṇā}.) To make? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਣਾਉਣਾ}}, \emph{baṇāuṇā}.) To sew? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਿਉਣਾ}}, \emph{siuṇā}.) To fill? (\textbf{\pa{ਭਰਨਾ}}, \emph{bharnā}.) To pull? (\textbf{\pa{ਖਿੱਚਣਾ}}, \emph{khiccṇā}.) To wake up? (\textbf{\pa{ਜਾਗਣਾ}}, \emph{jāgṇā}.) To drive? (\textbf{\pa{ਚਲਾਉਣਾ}}, \emph{calāuṇā}.) To say? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਹਿਣਾ}}, \emph{kahiṇā}.) To live? (\textbf{\pa{ਜੀਉਣਾ}}, \emph{jīuṇā}.) To spend? (\textbf{\pa{ਖ਼ਰਚਣਾ}}, \emph{kharcṇā}.) To save? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਚਾਉਣਾ}}, \emph{bacāuṇā}.) To sow? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੀਜਣਾ}}, \emph{bījṇā}.) To run? (\textbf{\pa{ਭੱਜਣਾ}}, \emph{bhajjṇā}.) To wander? (\textbf{\pa{ਘੁੰਮਣਾ}}, \emph{ghummṇā}.) To stop? (\textbf{\pa{ਰੁਕਣਾ}}, \emph{rukṇā}.) To believe? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੰਨਣਾ}}, \emph{mannṇā}.) To change? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਦਲਣਾ}}, \emph{badalṇā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
